prompt_text:
Continue the text below with exactly one short, natural, coherent English sentence. Return only the continuation, with no preamble or explanation:
An alien has kidnapped Matt Damon, not knowing what lengths humanity goes through to retrieve him whenever he goes missing. Little did the aliens know that Matt Damon is the president and the world would do anything to get him back safe and sound. 

Now these aliens are smart but not so much smarter than us so humanity has a chance.  The aliens are not so much stronger than us, we have a few tricks up our sleeves. Matt has a tracker on him for situations like this. The military knows at all times where Matt is. Currently they have him in Antarctica because that was the aliens hideout. The military knows this and begins gathering all they can and enlisting the helps of other countries military for an all out war to save President Damon.  

They begin making their approach to Antarctica. The aliens are not expecting this and are caught off guard. They messed with the wrong person. The aliens are oblivious to who they have in their possession. They took President Damon to experiment on him. They have no started yet and Damon is locked up in the spaceship without a plan of his own.  Then suddenly he hears a BOOM! The military has arrived and are shooting at the aliens! They are shooting from the ships and the ships have just sent out their pilots. Explosions everywhere. The aliens aren't going without a fight though. They get out their alien weapons to go on the offensive as well. They begin blasting using their alien weapons. They also send out some of their land and air support. It is all out chaos. Suddenly Damon hears another boom. But this one is different. It rocks the ship and makes the alien force field go down.
reference_text: Damon is free! He looks for a weapon since most of the aliens are fighting. He finds a cool looking alien rifle. He has no idea how to use it. Then a couple of aliens who were preparing to fight spots him. Damon panics and somehow shoots the weapon and scores a double kill.
